claim: The one-click sample resets without reading or changing a real saved session.
where: landing action, demo banner, privacy page, README
sandbox: fresh browser context; enter through /demo, create a real session, change and reset demo data, then confirm the real session is unchanged

claim: CSV contents and filenames stay in the browser; the free workflow loads no remote scripts, fonts, analytics, or tracking pixels.
where: landing facts, file controls, privacy page, footer, README
sandbox: fresh /demo context; compare a marked private value while recording every request and loaded resource

claim: The populated comparison works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: dedicated fresh browser context; load /demo, wait for service-worker control, set the context offline, and reload

claim: The parser keeps UTF-8 text, quoted commas, escaped quotes, and quoted line breaks.
sandbox: fresh /demo context with custom quoted UTF-8 files; compare and inspect rendered before/after field values

claim: One or more selected columns align business records.
sandbox: fresh /demo context with tenant and id as a composite key; assert exact changed and unchanged outcomes

claim: Reordered rows still yield exact added, removed, changed, and unchanged records.
where: landing copy, How it works, README
sandbox: fresh /demo sample whose after rows are reordered; assert each populated outcome count

claim: Duplicate keys are disclosed and excluded from automatic pairing counts.
where: How it works, result notice, README
sandbox: fresh /demo sample; assert the ambiguous count, duplicate rows, and exclusion notice

claim: The selected result filters control the CSV evidence export.
sandbox: fresh /demo sample; disable three filters, download the report, and assert its header and changed-only evidence rows

claim: A real local comparison returns after a refresh.
sandbox: fresh /demo entry; start for real, build a comparison, reload, and assert the filenames and report return

claim: Clear local session removes the real comparison from browser storage.
sandbox: fresh /demo entry; create a real session, confirm clear, reload, and assert the empty state remains

claim: A CSV at 50 MiB is accepted and a larger file is rejected.
sandbox: fresh /demo context; submit files at the exact boundary and one byte above it, then assert ready and error outcomes

claim: CSV comparison and filtered CSV export work without a license, payment, or account.
where: landing facts, Pro section, privacy page, terms, README
sandbox: fresh /demo context with no license; assert populated outcomes and inspect the downloaded CSV report

claim: Pro costs $19 once for one user, restores by token, exports JSON evidence, and sends no CSV data for verification.
where: Pro section, privacy page, terms, README
test: npm run test:claims -- --grep "@claim:pro-json" && npm run test:live-checkout
sandbox: fresh /demo entry; start for real, use a recorded valid verification response, restore the token, and inspect JSON; then verify the public hosted checkout registration

claim: The app uses exact selected keys and does not infer or fuzzy-match identities.
sandbox: fresh /demo context with visually similar but unequal keys; assert they remain an addition and removal

claim: A key-only one-column CSV supports added, removed, and unchanged reconciliation.
sandbox: fresh /demo context with one-column before and after files; assert exact output counts
